release_title: Round8: packed joint representations and evidence
release_body: Incremental frozen research evidence. The final report states measured outcomes and limitations; execution completion does not imply that every performance hypothesis succeeded. Archive exact bytes and LF Git identities are recorded separately. Earlier commits, tags, releases and assets are retained.
scope: Preparation template only. Add completed final confirmation/quiet analyses through their actual receipts before final freeze. Failure, diagnostic and unexecuted traces never become quality because a producer complete.json exists. Supply original isolated SR/jobs/*.source snapshots or a content-object collection with original inventories. Raw maintenance, tensors, images, weights and private routing remain private.
